plugins.name: efcore-gdpr-obfuscate
plugins.description: Scans EF Core migration files to detect GDPR-sensitive columns and generates an idempotent, deterministic SQL Server obfuscation script for dev/test environments.

plugins.name: efcore-squash-migrations
plugins.description: Squashes an entire EF Core migration history into a single migration and wires up safe startup logic so new databases get the full schema while existing (already-migrated) databases are marked up-to-date without re-running DDL or losing data.

plugins.name: netmedia-net8-to-net10-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrades and modernizes a .NET 8 solution to .NET 10 LTS through six gated phases - class libraries, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, MVC/Razor/Blazor websites, Azure Functions and EF Core - then rewrites the code to current .NET 10 idioms (WebApplication hosting, built-in OpenAPI, MapStaticAssets, HybridCache, isolated-worker Functions, EF Core 10 mappings, C# 14, .slnx, Central Package Management). Includes a solution scanner that reports every known upgrade blocker before any code is touched.
